career_ladder.note: Junior Engineers (Avar Abhiyanta) recruited by UPSSSC execute civil, electrical, and mechanical engineering projects across the Uttar Pradesh Public Works Department (PWD), Irrigation and Water Resources Department, Rural Engineering Department (RED), and Uttar Pradesh Awas Evam Vikas Parishad. Recruits enter at Pay Level 6 and advance into gazetted engineering leadership through departmental promotion quotas and exams.

exam_scheme.note: Candidates are shortlisted through their normalized UPSSSC PET score, followed by a single-stage Main Written Examination of 100 marks covering engineering technical subjects, computer applications, and Uttar Pradesh state awareness. Negative marking of 0.25 (1/4th) is deducted per wrong answer.

financial_package.note: Junior Engineer is positioned at Pay Level 6 (Pay Band ₹9,300–₹34,800 with Grade Pay ₹4,200) under the Uttar Pradesh Revised Pay Rules, 2016.
financial_package.pay_source_label: Uttar Pradesh Revised Pay Rules 2016 (7th CPC Pay Matrix Level 6)
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Level 6 entry basic pay of ₹35,400 at 58% DA (effective 01.07.2025), HRA (₹3,200 to ₹6,500 based on metro/district posting), field site inspection allowance, net of 10% NPS deduction (₹5,593), professional tax, and group insurance deductions.
official_perks: Dearness Allowance (DA) revised semi-annually per UP Finance Department notifications
House Rent Allowance (HRA) categorized by posting city tier (Class X, Y, Z)
Site inspection and official travel conveyance allowance
Medical reimbursement under UP Government Servants Medical Attendance Rules
National Pension System (NPS) with 14% matching employer contribution
Subsidized departmental rest house facilities and leave travel concessions
